title: Other Chicago bands and clubs: Coon-Sanders, Noone, the Nest
summary: He lists the Chicago acts he heard, Coon-Sanders at the Black Hawk, Jimmie Noone at the Apex/Nest and a stable on the north side.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Now, I did hear Coon Sanders at the Black Hawk and I did hear Jimmy Noon a couple of times. Was that the Apex Club?
Yeah, the Nest that was called first of the Apex.
The Nest is what I knew it at the time and then another place that we used to go was a stable.
Oh, yeah. Up on the north.
Yeah, the side of the river.
Just over the Chicago Bridge there and that's about it as far as Chicago who I heard and all.
